ClassicVectorTa remains semantic-v9: its own manifest-completeness debt defines v9 as the open pre-release composite authority that may append audited repairs; appended dual-ulcer repair tokens, host-source-sha256 DC24D3A254E2F61E41E7254B51D12BCD814B6BBEF50E4F087F5FC62F967D2A2C and cuda-source-sha256 0B871371B70F50B37B3DA60F3BA07A8A0A147CB83C7E309D81F7988F9DB0E3AC, and updated the v9 debt text. Validation: dual_ulcer_index_threshold_validity 2/2 (real M15 threshold/long/short finite after warmup, stream==batch bitwise; the pre-fix lane poisoned at row 5900), feature_registry 7/7, cci_cycle_classic_v9_source_contract 7/7, classic_cuda_production_route_source_contract dual_ulcer 2/2 with the contract updated to the repaired shared authority and CPU clamp, full_feature_validity_parity 25/25. Local limits: this machine has no nvcc/NVIDIA device, so the CUDA kernel text edit is source-contract and parity covered but not device-executed; no financial claim. No validation gate or cost assumption changed. Next: run bounded M5/H1/H4 canonical research only after this and the Quant-v5 repair are committed, with the exact data matrix/provenance re-pinned; do not treat the repaired columns as profitability evidence.
